integrity: Transition definitions, quantifiers, target states, and equality conditions are stated explicitly. Finite computations are reported only as checks and are not presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is an equality-case refinement of the published reset-threshold proof. The universal classification is proved symbolically; exhaustive power-automaton checks cover n from 5 through 16 and direct formula replay covers n from 5 through 100. Non-indexed or unpublished duplicate computations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Exactly four shortest reset words in the deficiency-two family \(D_n\)
